messages:
Samantha (Support): Acme compliance just opened an escalation. Their auditor can't pull older audit events for two subteams after we changed the org retention to 1y. Current events show, but queries for 2023-2024 return 403.

Acme Compliance: We can see recent entries but when we request events before 2024-04-01 we get a 403 with entitlement_missing. We need those records for a regulatory review.

Devon (Eng Support): can you paste the exact API call and response body?

Samantha (Support): They called the org audit endpoint with an org-scoped bearer token:

```
GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/orgs/ORG-83aef/events?start=2023-01-01&end=2024-04-01
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

Response was: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error":"access_denied",
  "message":"entitlement_missing: audit.read for org:ORG-83aef (child-team:TEAM-22)"
}
```

They claim the token includes org-level audit:read but not the team-level effective entitlements.

Maria (Identity Eng): interesting. entitlement inheritance should cover audit.read. any recent changes to the entitlement model or SCIM syncs for TEAM-22?

SRE Bot: Created ticket SUP-8721 for this escalation.

Samantha (Support): I pulled the admin entitlements snapshot for the requester:

```
GET /internal/admin/orgs/ORG-83aef/entitlements
=> [
  {"entitlement":"audit.read","scope":"org","granted_to":["ROLE-admin"]},
  {"entitlement":"audit_retention.1yr","scope":"org","granted_to":["ROLE-compliance"]}
]
```

But /effective for TEAM-22 only returns "audit_retention.1yr" and not "audit.read".

Devon (Eng Support): that smells like inheritance was toggled off for some entitlements during the migration. we added opt-ins for a handful of high-risk entitlements a while back.

Maria (Identity Eng): correct — in Nov we introduced an "inherit" flag and defaulted a subset of entitlements to non-inheritable. audit.read should still inherit, but maybe the flag was flipped accidentally for this org or during the migration. need the principal id and team id.

Samantha (Support): principal id: user_princ_9921, team id: TEAM-22. SCIM log from the customer shows a PATCH for TEAM-22 on 2025-12-03 02:14Z with members including user_princ_9921.

Devon (Eng Support): try a repro with an admin service token first to see if it's token-scope vs entitlement resolution.

Samantha (Support): admin service token returned 200 and historical events. So the data exists and the API route is fine. Failing is limited to that non-admin bearer token.

Maria (Identity Eng): hypothesis: ROLE-user tokens aren't getting effective org->team inherited entitlements because the effective-entitlement resolver incorrectly filters entitlements lacking inherit:true. quick mitigation: grant audit.read explicitly to TEAM-22 (team-level grant) or map TEAM-22 to a role that has the entitlement.

Samantha (Support): customer gave permission to try the team-level grant. I granted audit.read at team scope for TEAM-22 via admin console and they can now fetch the older events.

Acme Compliance: Confirmed. We can pull the 2023-2024 events now. No missing records, just permission denial.

Maria (Identity Eng): thanks. please dump the failing token claims (we asked the customer to hit /v1/debug/token/:id) so we can confirm claim contents.

Samantha (Support): token claims returned: {"sub":"user_princ_9921","org":"ORG-83aef","roles":["ROLE-user"],"scopes":["read:app"],"entitlements":["audit_retention.1yr"]}

Maria (Identity Eng): confirms — audit.read not present in token and effective entitlement calc didn't surface the org-level grant. I'll open a fix. plan: flip inherit=true for the compliance read/export entitlements at org scope and recompute effective entitlements for impacted orgs.

DevOps (infra): we'll need a small DB migration + cache invalidation job. recommend a canary recompute for ~100 orgs, then a full recompute. estimate 48-72h to code, test, and roll.

Devon (Eng Support): can we add an explainable diagnostics endpoint that returns the reason a principal lacked an entitlement (e.g., "granted_to role not mapped to team", "inherit=false")? would avoid this back-and-forth.

Maria (Identity Eng): yes adding an "explain entitlement" debug endpoint is on my short list. PR opened: entitlements-service#457. migration ticket linked. I'll add unit tests, SCIM role mapping e2e, and a post-deploy recompute.

Samantha (Support): I've updated SUP-8721 with the temporary workaround steps, the team-level fix we applied, and the planned timeline. Customer asked for email notification once the permanent fix is deployed.

Compliance Team: please note — legal asks we log that no data was deleted, only access was denied; retention metadata intact.

SRE Bot: SUP-8721 status set to in_progress, assigned to Maria (Identity Eng).

Action items (summary):
- Maria: change inheritance flags and open PR + tests (entitlements-service#457)
- DevOps: prepare migration and recompute plan, canary rollout (48-72h)
- Dev: add entitlement explain endpoint (low priority but helpful)
- Support (Samantha): notify customer when fix is live and keep SUP-8721 updated

Samantha (Support): thanks everyone — customer relieved by workaround but wants the root cause fixed. I'll draft a short customer-facing write-up after the migration completes. :+1:
